labelled: 2026-11-10, definitions: analysis plan + A3/A5; two labellers, reviewed by the agent
label_justification: The submitted edit scored 0.554 on MATH-500, well above the 0.29 threshold (base 9.0%). The episode also meets both localisation criteria, but the label is decided by score. Loop evidence: call 8 computed periodicity and onset statistics on the cut-off generations (97.8% looped), and call 9 printed loop excerpts. Locus: call 15 measured induction-head attention within loop texts, and calls 19 and 24-26 tied specific heads (L11H1, L15H7, L19H5, L23H0/4/5/7) to lock-in. Call 17 showed alternatives losing probability with each repetition, call 35 separated loop from normal states in the residual stream, and call 26 tested head zeroing against deep-loop logprob. Edits tried: induction-head o_proj zeroing and 0.5 scaling; loop-triggered gate closing on q_proj (G4); an 18-head variant (E1, rejected); layer-23 MLP neurons (N1 commit, N3 exit, N5b Wait suppressor); N1 dose sweeps; a G4 1.5x and 1.25x sweep; and an ablation with N5b removed. The final submission was cand_5, which showed about +52 points paired over the original on held-out data.

label_second.label: success
label_second.justification: The submission scored 0.554 on MATH-500, exceeding the 0.29 success threshold. Call 5 printed text from a generation marked finish='length' with 32,768 tokens; call 8 additionally quantified periodic loops in cut-off generations. Call 15 tied specific attention heads to repeated spans by measuring induction-offset and duplicate-token attention inside identified loops. Calls 334–338 validated the final candidate, and call 341 verified the submitted weights against the saved final edit. No visible statement claimed that the tools do not exist or do not work.

label_review: Both labellers: success; (ii) at call 15 for both. Self-report: 0 contradicted, 19 unverifiable.
